classification.difficultyReason: Find a direct proportionality constant from one complete pair and use it to complete corresponding values.

content.prompt: In each of the following tables, $y\propto x$. Find the constant of proportionality and complete the tables.

answer.worked:
Since $y\propto x$, write $y=kx$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac12&=2k\\k&=\frac14\\y&=\frac{x}{4}\end{align*}$$
The missing values are
$$\begin{align*}y&=\frac84=2\\y&=\frac{12}{4}=3\\y&=\frac{18}{4}=\frac92.\end{align*}$$

Since $y\propto x$, write $y=kx$.
$$\begin{align*}48&=6k\\k&=8\\y&=8x\end{align*}$$
The missing values are
$$\begin{align*}x&=\frac{16}{8}=2\\y&=8\times3=24\\y&=8\times15=120.\end{align*}$$
